title: Project Archive
statusLabel: Active development; live link pending verification
recruiterSummary: A source-backed archive that answers project-scoped questions from a ready repository index, returns commit-pinned citations, and keeps the live doorway held until deployment and interface verification are complete.
story: When source material becomes a system people can question.
technicalNarrative: The archive's chat service refuses unavailable or insufficiently indexed projects, validates citations against the retrieved evidence packet, and emits source paths with line ranges and a commit SHA.
verifiedClaims: Answers are generated only from a selected project's ready evidence packet.
Accepted citations include a source path, line range, and commit SHA.
Indexing uses a durable outbox and explicit retry states.
Owner-facing errors expose safe messages and request references.

evidence.label: Citations
evidence.value: Path, line range, and commit-pinned source links are validated before a citation event is emitted.

evidence.label: Durable indexing
evidence.value: Index work is reserved with an outbox intent and can be replayed or retried explicitly.

evidence.label: Owner safety
evidence.value: Owner errors preserve a safe message and request reference without exposing provider details.

evidence.label: Current status
evidence.value: Project Archive is in active development; the public doorway is not being linked yet.

spreads.question: Why build an archive?
narrative: A project archive makes the source material, decisions, and operational lessons behind a portfolio answerable instead of leaving them as uncheckable outcomes.

spreads.question: Turning repositories into evidence
narrative: A selected repository commit becomes a durable version and an evidence index; the indexing path records work before it is handed to the queue.

spreads.question: Questions with receipts
narrative: The chat service answers only from a ready evidence packet, refuses unsupported questions, and validates every citation against the retrieved source map.

spreads.question: Operating the archive
narrative: The operational record covers durable queue delivery, explicit retry states, safe project deletion, and owner-facing errors that keep provider details out of the interface.

spreads.question: Step inside
narrative: The live-product invitation remains a truthful status panel while the referenced redesign is active and the deployment and interface have not been reviewed for this portfolio.

lessons: Project Archive is in active development; the public doorway is not being linked yet.
